description: Researchers at the Institute for Information Transmission Problems of the Russian Academy of Sciences publish RealDirt, a waste-detection dataset collected in an operating recycling plant. The June 2024 Zenodo release contains 2,000 images covering plastic bottles, plastic bags and cartons, captured with an IDS UI-5250 CP Rev.2 camera and a nine-millimetre Azure lens. The archive is freely downloadable under CC BY 4.0. The images can train or benchmark sorting-system perception used within waste-facility digital twins or simulations of detection error. No related catalogue record explicitly covers RealDirt. The public page does not identify the plant, acquisition period, image dimensions, annotation scheme or train-test division. Its three material classes cannot represent the full incoming waste stream. Class balance, visual leakage between splits and prediction uncertainty were not independently assessed. Only repository metadata were inspected; images and annotations were not downloaded.
